expected_diagnosis: Guest has IPv6 but lacks IPv4 on target interface.
recommended_next_checks: nmcli -f IP4,IP6 dev show enp0s3; check provisioning panel
resolution_guidance: Verify IPv4 allocation and NetworkManager profile; restore using validated settings.
verification: IPv4 assigned, IPv4 route and TCP/22 work.
escalate_when: IPv4 address not provisioned to node.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
